budget_derivation.I/O_costs: logical/serialized bytes, synchronized wall and dispatch wall are recorded separately; physical I/O is unmeasured
budget_derivation.artifact_accounting: 194 MiB reserved = 96 MiB audit/store/receipt/log envelope + 2 MiB teacher cache + 96 MiB two-site extension/optimizer checkpoint. Checkpoint arithmetic: 4.22M trainable float32 parameters (2.90M reader + 1.32M compressor) plus two AdamW moment buffers; this is a bound, not a fit measurement
budget_derivation.artifact_read_accounting: 96 MiB checkpoint + 2 MiB teacher cache = 102760448 read bytes at restart
budget_derivation.audit_io: append-only journal: logical appended bytes equal appended bytes; physical SSD amplification and flush cost are not measured and are not claimed to be lower than v11. Lower audit cost is not better learning
budget_derivation.backbone_token_unit: each decode/parity forward reserves forwards=1 and input_tokens=256 (fixed right-padded context width)
budget_derivation.baseline_forwards: 8 worlds * 8 reserved tokens = 64; no source features
budget_derivation.basis: every stage is re-derived from the v12 mechanism, not projected from the v11 totals; all counts are worst-case reservations and none is refunded
budget_derivation.correction_forwards: 24 generated + 1 source forward; 2 tokenizer passes because the correction evicts the corrected record before the re-read
budget_derivation.deadline: monotonic and wall-clock outer deadline both persisted; the stricter remaining time wins, so a monotonic-clock restart cannot extend the budget
budget_derivation.fit_probe_forwards: per prefix, 32 worlds * (2 parity + 6 control + 6*8 generated) = 1792 backbone forwards, plus 96 source forwards; per world 4 tokenizer passes (release rebuild, provenance re-check after publication cleared C, live, wrong-world) and 7 release/ticket writes
budget_derivation.fitting_updates: 32 worlds * 16 passes = 512; each update reserves 1 backbone forward, 1 canonical span, 1 backward, 1 update and 1 receipt write
budget_derivation.prepare_forwards: 32 admissions * 1 canonical span = 32; 32 retrievals; 2 writes each
budget_derivation.read_descriptor_writes: a successful wait-based read persists three pending descriptors (initial pending, dispatch reservation, terminal); a waiting read that times out persists two; a read whose own dispatch fails is bounded by four, so every stage reserves 4 per read. Each explicit bounded caller resume persists at most two (one when it attaches to an in-flight ticket, none when refused before dispatch), so 2 of resume headroom is reserved per read. There is no automatic retry: at most four caller waits, then a typed refusal
budget_derivation.restart_forwards: 2 canary/update backbone forwards + 2 source spans recomputed from a cleared feature cache; 1 backward, 1 update, 1 model load, 2 restores (checkpoint and teacher cache) and their read bytes
budget_derivation.source_span_unit: one cache-missing canonical span reserves tokenizer_calls=1, source_encodes=1, source_token_bytes=256 and input_tokens=256 for the tokenizer, then forwards=1, source_feature_forwards=1, cache_misses/evictions/recomputations=1 and input_tokens=256 for the frozen source forward
budget_derivation.stage_wall: 30+180+45+30+60+90+4*500+4*900+60+540+60+140 = 6835 seconds of stage allocation inside the 7200-second whole-process-group envelope; the remaining 365 seconds are outer headroom, never a stage allowance
budget_derivation.teacher_forwards: 32 answers * 8 reserved tokens + 32 target forwards = 288; no source features
budget_derivation.total_forwards: 64 + 3 + 32 + 288 + 4*256 + 4*1888 + 2 + 784 + 25 + 4 = 9778; a source forward appears twice on purpose: once as a frozen backbone forward (forwards) and once as source_feature_forwards, because v12 dispatches both
budget_derivation.total_prompt_tokenizer_passes: 16 + 2 + 0 + 128 + 4*256 + 4*640 + 2 + 224 + 6 + 4 = 3966 chat-template passes, charged separately from canonical-source tokenization
budget_derivation.total_writes: 5 + 9 + 2 + 225 + 34 + 4*129 + 4*323 + 7 + 114 + 16 + 8 = 2228 declared writes, including descriptor persists, one observed source-cost receipt per closed stage, and the receipts written outside a stage
